decisions.decision: drei shaderMaterial + Vite ?raw import for GLSL sources
decisions.rationale: One shader, 7 states via uniforms — one draw call, no material swaps. ?raw survives into built bundle.
Pitfall 1 — hook re-subscription per frame kills 60 FPS. Lint grep enforces.

decisions.decision: Two-path Reduce Motion defense: shader uReduceMotion + CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion)
decisions.rationale: Bus a11y message may be delayed on first launch; CSS still catches. Defense-in-depth.
Phase 2 BusOutbound doesn't carry text-part id; synthesize rather than extend schema (breaking). Phase 4 orchestrator will emit richer events.

decisions.decision: awaitingApproval sentinel hides args in ToolCallCard even though Phase 5 MCP-04 is authoritative
decisions.rationale: Defense-in-depth for Pitfall 9 — webview seatbelt so a permissive renderer can't undo Swift-side substitution.

decisions.decision: Non-tokenDelta event on active turn closes active text-part
decisions.rationale: Chronological interleaving: tool-call between tokens must produce separate text-parts, not concatenation. Test Ch1 enforces.
Stable entry-point is source-of-truth-committed; hashed assets regenerate on every build via scripts/build-webview.sh. Reduces commit noise + keeps repo lean.

decisions.decision: Pre-build script ordering: build-webview.sh → check-single-writer-hudstate.sh → verify-entitlements --pre-codesign → codesign.sh → verify-entitlements --post-codesign
decisions.rationale: Webview bundle must exist before codesign; single-writer lint runs pre-entitlement to fail fast on the canonical R1 H-A3 anti-pattern; entitlement verify bookends the signature.

decisions.decision: Three dormant AsyncStream continuations retained by AppDelegate (agent/voice/confirmation)
decisions.rationale: Swift 6 continuation-drop would terminate the coordinator's three for-await Tasks. Retention keeps the coordinator alive. Phase 4 (agent) + Phase 5 (confirmation) + Phase 6 (voice) replace these with real producer streams.
AppDelegate is the wiring layer and must construct .hudState(...) via the emit closure. Phase 4+ should add no new sites. Lint still catches voice/agent/anyone-else constructing .hudState directly.

decisions.decision: webviewEntryFilename internal property as test seam on AppDelegate
decisions.rationale: Less invasive than subclassing JarvisHUDPanel to observe the loaded URL. Property is set to 'index' in installBus(); test W6 asserts equality.
